answer: We resist Sybil attacks by anchoring identity to cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. Each verified agent holds a unique state commitment, like a lustrous pearl concealing sensitive credentials. Staking costs grow superlinearly with quadratic penalties; a Sybil swarm face exponential capital exhaustion, dividing their stake like stalks of yarrow in an ancient ritual. Validated nodes mirror verified computational proofs across the network to expose duplicates.
